evidence.locator: freeze_reference; select_candidate; compare; main; companion README and provenance.json
evidence.supports: Accepted local scoring interfaces retain full author grid, dual per-channel CC, training-only selection and candidate contrasts. They do not fit native models or authenticate source-paper predictions, observation use or original sanitization.

target.description: Joint one-step-ahead prediction of neural activity and 2D cursor position/velocity in Figure 6h-i, comparing nonlinear mapping locations.

dataset.description: Sabes grid-reaching release, exact Zenodo record 3854034 (v2); source spike timestamps and kinematics, not its precomputed Makin decoder-result CSV.

cohort.description: Paper: monkey I, seven wideband-available sessions from 20160622/01 through 20160921/01, random 32 of 96 M1 electrodes with 77-99 units. Exact electrode identities and session crosswalk remain unverified.

split.description: Five equal continuous temporal test segments per session; models fit remaining segments. Architecture search uses two inner training folds. State dimensions and architecture are selected from training data.

inputs.description: Training uses neural and behavior observations; test inference uses past neural observations, without test behavior.

preprocessing.description: Recover original binning, Gaussian smoothing, alignment and boundary handling for the exact channels. The existing historical_symmetric/prospective_causal profiles are declarations, not verified native preparation. Changing filter causality changes the input condition.

metric.description: Pearson CC separately for each behavior/neural channel: covariance divided by the product of standard deviations; arithmetic channel mean gives each fold score. Higher is better in both coordinates.

aggregation.description: Figure reporting averages 35 session-fold outcomes. Author code has invalid-row filtering and later channel sanitization; the original caller and resulting inclusion masks must be recovered before the strict local full-coverage scorer is equivalent.

full_panel.description: Figure 6h-i original spiking experiment: seven sessions of monkey I, five temporal folds each, seven alternatives (fully linear; only A-prime, K, Cy or Cz nonlinear; flexible decoding-focused; flexible self-prediction-focused), both neural and four-channel behavior CC. Retain all eight dimensions 1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128, all 90 training-search architectures, training-only selected models, every per-channel/fold score, 35-fold mean and SEM for each method/endpoint, all joint-frontier contrasts and the Cz-only localization conclusion. The local interface covers 1960 author dimension cases and 245 selected cases. Scalar findings below represent 28 source-reported mean/SEM summaries and one categorical conclusion only; they do not represent or replace mandatory prediction arrays, training-search records, masks, selected-model identities and complete nonlinearity companion comparisons. Original numeric panel, exact channel/session identities and source sanitization remain unresolved.

permitted_observations.description: Fit and choose architectures/dimensions using only neural and behavior observations within the original outer training partition, with two inner training folds for architecture selection. Original test predictions are one step ahead and use past neural observations only; test behavior is an evaluation target and never an inference input. Both information conditions retain identical original observations, cohort, folds, preprocessing and evaluation; author code is the only additional information in the +author-code condition. Authentic preparation and enforcement remain unverified.
